title: Forward Deployed Computational Biologist
description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Please submit your CV in English Salary range: $128,000 - $150,000 Ideal start date: January or February 2027 About the role: We are seeking a Forward Deployed Computational Biologist to operate at the intersection of AI, software systems, and biology. In this role, you will work directly with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI solutions for complex scientific problems as part of Owkin’s agentic platform, K Pro, to fully meet specific customer needs. This is a hands-on, client-facing role. You will spend time at the customer’s premises, turning ambiguous scientific challenges—such as discovering novel drug targets or disease subtypes—into reliable and scalable agentic solutions. You will be responsible for both the scientific rigor of the analytical workflows and the technical robustness of their implementation and deployment, bridging the gap between science and real-world application. In particular, you will: Deploy & Custom-build : Tailor Owkin’s agentic AI platform, K Pro, to specific client needs by implementing new analytical workflows, and integrate our platform into the clients’ existing workflows. Solve Scientific Problems : Translate complex biological and operational questions into concrete computational workflows, utilizing deep clinical and multi-omics data (genomics, transcriptomics, etc.) and computational biology methodologies. Rapid Prototyping : Iterate quickly with users to validate solutions, balancing speed and quality to ensure effective, measurable impact. Collaboration : Work alongside Customer Success Managers, R&D data scientists, biologists, and software engineers to ensure the delivery of high-quality scientific insights. Knowledge Transfer : Communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders—from clinicians and biologists to technical engineering teams—to ensure alignment and adoption. Participation in a team-wide on-call rotation is required. This role requires frequent international travel to support our global operations and client needs. Anticipated destinations include the Owkin Paris office as well as various client premises across the UK, US, France, Germany, and Switzerland. To facilitate this travel schedule, the successful candidate must be based in close proximity to a major international airport or major train station . About you Required qualifications / experience: Education : MSc/PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biology, Computer Science, or a related field. Proven expertise and impact in analyzing complex data, such as real-world clinical data and multimodal omics (e.g, bulk, spatial/single-cell, proteomics) and high-throughput experimental data. Biological knowledge : Strong knowledge of molecular biology and at least one major therapeutic area (oncology, Immunology & Inflammation, neurology, …). Bias for action : Ability to operate in fast-paced environments, managing ambiguity, and driving progress toward delivery. Engineering Proficiency : Very strong programming skills in Python; ability to both ideate and conduct exploratory analyses and data visualisations to aid interpretation; and write clean, production-grade code. Strong familiarity with coding agents. AI/ML Experience : Familiarity with machine learning concepts (e.g., cross-validation, statistical tests) and frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.). Experience with LLMs and agentic AI frameworks is a plus. Communication : Exceptional ability to translate scientific complexity for non-technical internal and external stakeholders. Preferred qualifications/bonus: Experience in a Biotech/Pharma environment and excellent understanding of the different steps and respective needs of the typical Pharma drug discovery pipeline. Demonstrated ability to write production-level code in deployed products. #LI-MD1 What we offer Flexible work organization Friendly and informal working environment Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds Recruitment Process & Security Please complete the form and submit your CV. Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability. Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information: Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn. Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @ owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby). The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @ Owkin.com . The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information; Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format. If you think that you have been a victim of fraud, Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/ Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address hiring@owkin.com contact the following authorities: [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/ [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

title: AI Biologist - Aging & Longevity
description: Latch builds rigorous scientific benchmarks ( benchmarks.bio ) for AI agents across biology. We work with frontier labs and pharma to measure whether agents can handle real biological workflows: the messy, multi-layer reasoning that matters in the field. We’re seeking an AI Biologist to join our Aging & Longevity team to help accelerate the discoveries AI can make in aging biology. About the Role You will use your scientific expertise to improve the ability of AI agents to reason like expert geroscientists. You will build tasks which evaluate aging-specific analysis capabilities and scientific taste. Your judgment will set the standard AI agents are evaluated against. In this role, you will help accelerate research across the entire aging and longevity ecosystem. You will work as part of a team of scientists and software engineers building benchmarks testing capabilities ranging from basic geroscience research to therapeutic discovery and development, including: Development, application, and interpretation of biomarkers of aging, such as proteomic and epigenetic clocks Design and analysis of experiments related to the Hallmarks of Aging , such as quantification of cellular senescence, identification of stem cell exhaustion, and measurement of genomic instability Integration and analysis of diverse data modalities, such as transcriptomics, proteomics, DNA methylation, functional measurements, health records, and imaging data Use of high-throughput screening data to discover and prioritize candidate anti-aging drug targets Requirements Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in biology, bioinformatics, computational biology, or a related field Contribution to published research in aging biology or an adjacent field (cancer, epigenetics, immunology, etc.), such as a first-author paper, thesis, or independent project. Deep familiarity with AI coding tools An ability to convey your thoughts clearly and precisely; i.e., strong scientific writing skills High agency and initiative Demonstrated track record of using R or Python to analyze scientific data Deep computational or experimental experience: Computational: applying machine learning, data analysis, or statistics to -omics data; methods development; statistical genetics Experimental: hands-on wet-lab experience performing experiments and assays relevant to aging research (e.g., sequencing library prep, studies involving model organisms, senescence assays, flow cytometry, cell or organoid culture, in vivo intervention studies) Strongly Preferred Industry experience in biotech, tech, or a similar field Multiple first-author publications Familiarity with frequently used repositories of scientific data, such as: the UK Biobank, TCGA, GEO, ENCODE, etc. Compensation $140K–$180K OTE (on-target earnings), with no ceiling. Your pay is your OTE times your weekly quota attainment. Hit quota, earn your OTE; double it, earn double. Example: $150K OTE at double quota = $300K. Your first 4 weeks (ramp) are paid at full OTE while you learn our workflows. You’re paid full OTE whenever quota can’t fairly apply: when a new project is starting, the platform goes down, or we pull you onto a special project. Benefits & Employment In the US: full-time W-2 Guaranteed floor (“base salary”) set by your state, paid on the 15th and last day of every month Health, dental, vision: 100% covered for you, 50% for dependents 401(k) (no match) PTO: 15 days to start, more as you’re promoted Outside the US: contractor Paid on performance. We want our team to have stability, so we pay 60% of your monthly OTE up front as an advance, balanced against your earnings in later paychecks. US benefits don’t apply. Growth Two tracks, based on output. Individual contributor: six levels, so up to five promotions, with OTE rising at each one. Management: after your first promotion, you can move into managing a pod or keep growing on the IC track. Location & Work Authorization Location: remote or onsite at our Mission Bay office in San Francisco. Onsite is preferred: working side by side is how we share knowledge and keep our work rigorous. We have a global team, and remote teammates regularly visit the office. Work authorization: we sponsor H-1B (new and transfers), O-1, and TN, and support STEM OPT. Culture @ Latch We practice radical transparency: you’ll know how the company is doing, what’s working, and what isn’t. It’s always us against the problem, never each other. We’re opinionated but respectful of each other’s time, and we think through possible solutions before bringing a problem to anyone. We use AI constantly, so we reward original expert judgment, not AI output passed off as your own. You’ll start on the bench that fits your expertise and can move across teams as you build a track record. Outside of work: company outings most months, team off-sites, and a community that does cycling, soccer, figure skating, boxing, running, martial arts, music, books, and game nights. Interview Process Apply. If your profile matches, we’ll send you a take-home project. Take-home project (HackerRank). We review it as soon as it arrives. Technical interview with a Member of Technical Staff (pod lead). Culture interview with our C-suite. Offer. Background check, once you accept.

title: Manager of Bioinformatics (Oncology Product Development)
description:
Natera is currently seeking a Bioinformatics Manager to join the Bioinformatics team focused on Oncology Product Development. In this role, the individual will manage a team of Bioinformaticians and Data Scientists and provide technical leadership in the design, development and validation of ctDNA-based diagnostic tests. This position requires extensive cross-functional collaboration with biostatistics, molecular biology, software engineering and commercial departments. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioinformatics and data science, optimally with experience in the LDT assay development space, and an established record of project and technical leadership.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical leadership for product development projects by representing the bioinformatics team in cross-functional interactions and moving products through the full development process through validation and commercial launch.
  • Lead the effort to optimize workflows, improve tools and pressure test analysis pipelines for diagnostic tests, including the detection of cancer-associated variants and the implementation of evidence-based quality control thresholds.
  • Supervise bioinformatics scientists and data scientists, managing their technical contributions, prioritizing resources, and taking responsibility for their technical and professional development.
  • Provide input on experiment design, analysis and interpretation based on expert understanding of Natera’s technology and relevant mathematical principles.
  • Work at a high level of independence and responsibilities in carrying out assignments.
  • Contribute to our intellectual property portfolio.
  • Set standards for rigorous data analysis and lead the production of high-quality documentation. 

QUALIFICATIONS:

Requirements:

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a quantitative discipline (bioinformatics, engineering, applied mathematics, statistics, or similar).
  • Minimum of 4-8 years of post-graduate experience in a data science and/or bioinformatics role and 1-3 years of experience as technical lead in diagnostics or a related field
  • Experience moving algorithm-based products through commercialization and launch in a medical or biological application such as diagnostic testing, medical imaging, or biotechnology
  • 1-2 years of management experience leading a technical team with demonstrable evidence of leadership and team management skills.

Desirable, but not required:

  • Prior experience analyzing cancer-associated variant detection data

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Experience using Python or R for scientific data analysis and visualization.
  • Strong foundation in statistical modeling/machine learning, including probability theory and estimation/classification methods.
  • Experience with analysis of next-generation sequencing data, preferably including algorithm development or optimization.
  • Proven ability to apply mathematical principles to solve real estimation problems and implement practical solutions.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills to independently make sound judgments and find creative solutions to moderately complex problems.
  • Experience leading technical projects, including defining and meeting project milestones, delegating tasks to more junior team members, and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables.
  • Excellent communication skills and the desire to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus

  • Long-term equity awards

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range
$154,000—$192,500 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. 

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

For more information:
- BBB announcement on job scams 
- FBI Cyber Crime resource page

title: Data Scientist
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

2141 -  Data Scientist

Reporting to: Solution Architect

Role Summary and Impact :  

The Data Scientist reports to Solutions Architect and is responsible for designing, developing & deploying data modelling and automation solutions for a leading client across markets, the portfolio of brands. You should have a strong understanding of the concepts and tools in data enrichment, automation and agentic space. You focus on methodological depth and the correct application of data science techniques. You translate complex business questions into robust data models and automation workflows and work closely with engineers to bring these models into production in a scalable and maintainable way. You'll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters - for people and the planet, extending this impact directly to our client's strategic objectives.

What will you do :

  • Actively explore and identify the latest techniques related to DS, ML and automation/agentic techniques.
  • Perform hypothesis testing, data preparation and product prototyping based on modern statistical and DS/ML and agentic methods.
  • Research, develop and apply DS/ML/agentic models to solve business and clients’ problems effectively.
  • Use your knowledge to anticipate, identify, and address data issues related to redundancies, quality, and bias. Apply rigorous data cleaning and preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality data for modelling.
  • Lead data science projects, blending various data science techniques as needed to achieve optimal performance and actionable insights. Continuously explore innovative and novel approaches to improve modelling accuracy and efficiency.
  • Collaborate directly with internal analytics and business teams, to understand and document requirements, and deliver data science solutions that meet their specific business needs.
  • Monitor data quality, troubleshoot issues, and implement improvements to ensure data reliability.
  • Apply your communication, collaboration and emotional intelligence skills to effectively convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with other teams and departments.

What you’ll need :

  • Proven experience in in applied data science, analytics, or ML engineering.
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large-scale, multi-source data.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative coding workflows.
  • Advanced Python skills, incl. pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, scipy, statsmodels for modelling and analytics.
  • Bachelors or advanced degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Math, or Sciences is preferred.
  • Experience in building and execution of advanced solutions for audience analytics and insights.
  • Strong analytic and problem-solving skills, understanding and experience in application of AI methodologies for data manipulation and insight. 
  • Experience with data visualization platforms beyond Power BI/Tableau.
  • Sufficient knowledge of data governance practices including data QA, general naming taxonomy, data & platform integration, etc. 
  • Ability to communicate analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders clearly and impactfully.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. title: Associate Scientist III, Cardiac Modeling
description: The Opportunity insitro is a physical AI company dedicated to unlocking causal human biology and accelerating the delivery of better medicines to patients. Our unique Virtual Human™ platform identifies novel, high-impact genetic intervention points, which our TherML™ platform translates into therapeutics—whether small molecules, biologics, or oligos. With multiple programs in metabolic disease and neuroscience advancing toward the clinic, and our first IND submission slated for the second half of this year, we are at a pivotal inflection point. We are seeking an Associate Scientist III to join our cardiac disease biology team. In this role, you will support the development and application of iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte (iPSC-CM) models to study the genetic and molecular underpinnings of cardiovascular disease — working at the intersection of human stem cell biology, cardiac physiology, and scalable experimental platforms to generate the datasets that fuel our ML-driven drug discovery efforts. You will design and execute experiments, optimize differentiation workflows, develop functional and scalable functional assays to connect cellular phenotypes to disease mechanisms and therapeutic targets. Based in South San Francisco, this position reports directly to Senior Scientist, Cardiometabolic Disease - Translational Genetics and requires you to be onsite at our South San Francisco office 5 days per week . Responsibilities iPSC-CM Platform & Model Development Differentiation & QC: Support the generation and maintenance of iPSC lines and their differentiation into cardiomyocytes in 2D format (monolayers), implementing rigorous quality control points at each stage of the pipeline and with emphasis on production scalability Genetic Disease Models: Assist in building isogenic iPSC-CM disease models — including patient and CRISPR-edited lines carrying disease-associated variants — and characterizing the cellular model to study cardiovascular pathophysiology Functional Assays & Disease Modeling Functional Readouts: Support the development and optimization of functional assays relevant to cardiovascular disease —contractility, electrophysiology, calcium handling, stress responses, high-content imaging — in formats compatible with high-throughput data acquisition Rigor & Reproducibility: Documentation including writing/reviewing technical procedures and SOPs, presentation of results in team meetings and maintaining laboratory notebook with scientific rigor Cross-functional Partnership Target Identification: Contribute to target identification and validation efforts by connecting cellular phenotypes to human genetic evidence, aligning around the team and company goals to advance drug discovery About You Experience & Qualifications Qualifications and previous experience: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in biology, biochemistry, or related discipline with at least 2 years of relevant experience in the biotech/biopharma industry Cell culture and iPSC-CM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in iPSC culture, cardiac directed differentiation and iPSC-CM model characterization in 2D (monolayer) format. Prior experience in 3D/engineered heart tissue platforms or organoids is a plus Genetic Disease Modeling: Previous experience developing genetic iPSC-CM disease models — patient-derived lines, CRISPR-edited isogenic pairs — to study cardiovascular mechanisms Cardiovascular Biology: Background in cardiomyocyte biology and/or cardiovascular disease is preferred Functional Assays: Experience with functional assays relevant to cardiomyocyte biology (contractility, calcium, electrophysiology, imaging, stress responses). Prior exposure and experience working with high-throughput platforms and/or automated systems is a plus Molecular Assays: Hands-on expertise in molecular assays, such as PCR, RT-qPCR, Western Blot and immunofluorescence Scientific Communication: Track record of executing rigorous experiments and communicating findings clearly in publications, presentations or internal reports Core Competencies Cross-functional and Curious Collaborator: You are comfortable managing multiple tasks efficiently, communicating clearly and effectively, building open and collaborative relationships and are curious about implementing novel ML models into functional biology Independent & Adaptive: You thrive in a fast-paced environment working both independently and as part of a small, dedicated team while staying aligned with the team objectives Scientific Rigor and Attention to Detail : You excel at designing and executing experiments with the utmost scientific rigor, strong attention to detail and a positive and go-getter attitude towards unexpected results and challenges Compensation & Benefits at insitro Our target starting salary for successful US-based applicants for this role is $107,000 - $114,000. To determine starting pay, we consider multiple job-related factors including a candidate's skills, education and experience, market demand, business needs, and internal parity. We may also adjust this range in the future based on market data. This role is eligible for participation in our Annual Performance Bonus Plan (based on company targets by role level and annual company performance) and our Equity Incentive Plan, subject to the terms of those plans and associated policies. In addition, insitro also provides our employees: 401(k) plan with employer matching for contributions Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as mental health and well-being support Open, flexible vacation policy Paid parental leave of at least 16 weeks to support parents who give birth, and 10 weeks for a new parent (inclusive of birth, adoption, fostering, etc) Quarterly budget for books and online courses for self-development New hire stipend for home office setup Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Access to free onsite baristas and daily lunch for employees who are either onsite or hybrid Access to a free commuter bus network that provides transport to and from our South San Francisco HQ from locations all around the Bay Area insitro is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion need to be at the foundation of our culture. We work hard to bring together diverse teams–grounded in a wide range of expertise and life experiences–and work even harder to ensure those teams thrive in inclusive, growth-oriented environments supported by equitable company and team practices. All candidates can expect equitable treatment, respect, and fairness throughout the interview process. #LI-Hybrid Please be aware of recruitment scams: we never request payments, all recruitment communications are from @ insitro.com , and if in doubt, contact us at info@insitro.com . Twist Bioscience's Tech Transfer team is hiring a Senior Research Associate in Wilsonville, Oregon, to help new products and process improvements, with a particular focus on supporting orders ahead of full integration and scale. You will perform manual production steps for workflows that have not yet been fully automated, while partnering closely with R&D scientists and operations to vet new processes before and during their transfer into manufacturing. This person should be able to run experiments independently, communicate effectively, and optimize processes to drive CPI and NPI success, executing experiments that deliver high-quality end products for our customers. The work can vary between DNA and protein work, so the ability to learn new techniques and methodologies quickly is a real asset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently design, execute, and troubleshoot experiments, escalating when plans fall outside established protocols.
  • Support the build-out and vetting of new processes ahead of launch, working closely with R&D scientists, automation engineers, operators, and LIMS developers to confirm a process is ready for production.
  • Perform manual experiments with the intention of automating them for production processing of new or in-development workflows, helping fulfill early access orders while automation is still being built out.
  • Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, and risks before they reach manufacturing, and help implement optimizations.
  • Serve as a vigilant check on process quality, catching inconsistencies or at-risk steps and raising them before they affect downstream production or customer orders.
  • Support the writing of work instructions and training materials for manufacturing operators.
  • Operate a range of automated and manual lab equipment to execute experiments and production runs.
  • Support testing & validating Twist's LIMS platforms to generate, track, and analyze data.
  • Collect, analyze, and summarize data, and communicate findings clearly across cross-functional teams.
  • Mentor and train others on new processes and best practices.
  • Maintain thorough, organized, and audit-ready experimental and production records.

Qualifications and Required Skills

  • B.S. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or a closely related field, with at least 4 years of relevant industry or research experience; or an M.S. in a related field with at least 2 years of relevant experience.
  • Strong, hands-on background in molecular biology techniques, DNA or protein purification, DNA quantification, PCR, enzymatic and or cell-based assays, including antibody characterization assays.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise sound scientific judgment with minimal day-to-day direction.
  • Comfortable partnering cross-functionally with R&D and operations, as well as automation engineers, LIMS developers, and R&D scientists to support building and vetting new processes.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly and work effectively across teams.
  • Able to prepare technical documents, including SOPs, data summaries, and technical or analytical reports.
  • Comfortable working in a LEAN manufacturing or controlled laboratory environment, including supporting manual processing ahead of automation.
  • Self-motivated and detail-oriented, with a track record of catching issues before they escalate.
  • Experience mentoring or training other lab staff.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working with lab automation.
  • Experience with SQL and/or JSON.
  • Experience using LIMS systems.
  • Experience working with antibodies.
  • Experience supporting new product or process launches, including Early Access or limited-release programs.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing lab environments.

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better.   • Drive a platform mindset: reusable, configurable capabilities that serve multiple assays and labs instead of one-off builds.

About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team!

Real Chemistry is looking for driven, savvy game changers who are ready to dive into the trenches and make an immediate impact. We are currently seeking an Account Manager with client services experience in healthcare. The position offers a great opportunity for an individual with a passion for healthcare to work with leading clients in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices and health IT fields. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What You’ll Do:

  • Responsible for exceptional client service and account management activities for 3-4 accounts
  • In collaboration with account associate, senior management and project management staff, drive flawless and timely project execution and high-touch client communications
  • Participates in development of clients’ marketing strategies and tactics; collaborates with multiple internal stakeholders to ensure consensus around tactics’ scope and approach
  • Support overall account development, resourcing fiscal performance and growth

  • Ensure client feedback is gathered, understood and addressed as appropriate across deliverables and internally

  • Sets meetings, provides agendas and contact reports
  • Ability to run client calls or meetings independently
  • Manage account finances; must be able to track budget, raise invoices and POs

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What You Should Have:

  • Highly organized with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration
  • Professional presence, performs with a sense of urgency and with a client service orientation
  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment
  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget
  • Has good understanding of social media vehicles and is comfortable managing and drafting communications around them
  • Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills
  • Good management of Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) – particularly PowerPoint
  • Excellent business communication ability including informal/formal presentation and writing skills; this includes confident public speaking both internally and externally with clients, vendors, and affiliates
  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines
  • Able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met
  • Able to devise and articulate solutions to problems on an ongoing basis
  • Able to clearly communicate project updates, scopes and recommendations to clients
  • Ability to develop project scopes and client and vendor contracts
  • Demonstrated experience with media monitoring, research and taking on projects with limited supervision
  • BA or equivalent work experience require

title: AI Biologist - Gene Therapy Discovery
description: Latch builds rigorous scientific benchmarks ( benchmarks.bio ) for AI agents across biology. We work with frontier labs and pharma to measure whether agents can handle real biological workflows: the messy, multi-layer reasoning that matters in the field. We're seeking an AI Biologist to join our Gene Therapy Discovery team, pushing what AI can achieve in vector and payload design. About the Role You will be the scientific authority on ground truth, testing whether agents can reason like an expert gene therapy scientist. The data misleads constantly: a genome copy is not an expressed transgene, a titer is not an infectious unit, and enrichment in a library screen is not tropism. Knowing what the evidence actually supports is the work. You will build the tasks and datasets behind our benchmarks across AAV, lentiviral, and non-viral delivery, from target tissue to candidate nomination. Build the task Write gold-standard answers with the rationale an experienced vector scientist would defend. Design scenarios across the discovery arc: capsid or vector selection, promoter and regulatory element choice, payload design within packaging limits, transduction and expression, tropism, and early immunogenicity triage. Curate datasets from real programs: barcoded library NGS at DNA and RNA level, qPCR and ddPCR genome titers, capsid titers by ELISA or AUC, infectious unit assays, transduction across cell types and MOIs, payload expression, single-cell or spatial tropism, biodistribution, innate immune readouts. Build analysis pipelines in Python where useful, with tolerances that hold across replicates and analytical methods. Set the hard calls Catch the artifact. A variant enriched because it replicates or packages well, not because it transduces. DNA-level barcode recovery that counts uptake rather than completed transduction, so variants failing a late step still score. Barcode frequencies skewed by GC content, RT-PCR efficiency, or excess PCR cycles. An empty-to-full ratio that moves depending on whether it came from AUC, mass photometry, or a capsid-to-genome titer ratio, which overestimates empties. Partial genomes that count toward vector genome titer and read as infectious but add no potency. Transgene mRNA present with no detectable protein. Adjudicate conflicts. In vitro transduction against in vivo tropism. Weak bulk expression as inefficient delivery or as tight tropism for a rare cell type. A DNA-level transduction deficit against promoter silencing. Pre-existing neutralizing antibodies against intrinsic capsid performance. Then name the experiment that settles it. Weigh the tradeoffs. Tropism breadth versus specificity, expression level versus durability, payload size versus packaging capacity, promoter strength versus cell-type restriction, and when a potency gain costs immunogenicity or manufacturability. Judge the agent Interrogate reasoning step by step, and challenge conclusions that would not survive a project review. Pinpoint where agents go wrong: why the step fails, what an expert would do, what evidence would change the call. Score confidence, rewarding explicit uncertainty over overconfident calls on ambiguous data. Requirements PhD in molecular biology, virology, genetics, bioengineering, or a related field. An MS with equivalent hands-on program experience also qualifies. 2 to 6 years hands-on in gene therapy at a biotech or pharma, with your own analysis work in the last two years. You have personally generated or analyzed data that decided which vector, capsid, promoter, or payload advanced, and you can name the threshold and the call. Direct experience with at least one of: capsid or vector engineering and library screening, promoter and regulatory element design, transduction and expression assays, tropism or biodistribution analysis, or vector immunogenicity. Deep in one of those, fluent across the others. Strong experimental design, quantitative analysis, and statistics. AI-ready from day one: daily use of Claude, Cursor, or similar, with the judgment to spot where model reasoning is technically correct but scientifically unsound, and the confidence to overrule it. Bonus: Python or R for your own analyses. Gene editing delivery or non-viral delivery (LNP, nanoparticle, electroporation). Compensation $140K–$180K OTE (on-target earnings), with no ceiling. Your pay is your OTE times your weekly quota attainment. Hit quota, earn your OTE; double it, earn double. Example: $150K OTE at double quota = $300K. Your first 4 weeks (ramp) are paid at full OTE while you learn our workflows. You’re paid full OTE whenever quota can’t fairly apply: when a new project is starting, the platform goes down, or we pull you onto a special project. Benefits & Employment In the US: full-time W-2 Guaranteed floor (“base salary”) set by your state, paid on the 15th and last day of every month Health, dental, vision: 100% covered for you, 50% for dependents 401(k) (no match) PTO: 15 days to start, more as you’re promoted Outside the US: contractor Paid on performance. We want our team to have stability, so we pay 60% of your monthly OTE up front as an advance, balanced against your earnings in later paychecks. US benefits don’t apply. Growth Two tracks, based on output. Individual contributor: six levels, so up to five promotions, with OTE rising at each one. Management: after your first promotion, you can move into managing a pod or keep growing on the IC track. Location & Work Authorization Location: remote or onsite at our Mission Bay office in San Francisco. Onsite is preferred: working side by side is how we share knowledge and keep our work rigorous. We have a global team, and remote teammates regularly visit the office. Work authorization: we sponsor H-1B (new and transfers), O-1, and TN, and support STEM OPT. Culture @ Latch We practice radical transparency: you’ll know how the company is doing, what’s working, and what isn’t. It’s always us against the problem, never each other. We’re opinionated but respectful of each other’s time, and we think through possible solutions before bringing a problem to anyone. We use AI constantly, so we reward original expert judgment, not AI output passed off as your own. You’ll start on the bench that fits your expertise and can move across teams as you build a track record. Outside of work: company outings most months, team off-sites, and a community that does cycling, soccer, figure skating, boxing, running, martial arts, music, books, and game nights. Interview Process Apply. If your profile matches, we’ll send you a take-home project. Take-home project (HackerRank). We review it as soon as it arrives. Technical interview with a Member of Technical Staff (pod lead). Culture interview with our C-suite. Offer. Background check, once you accept.

title: Manufacturing Associate - IgG
description:
We are looking for motivated, enthusiastic individuals to join our Twist Bioscience Operations team in Wilsonville, OR. The Manufacturing Associate, IgG Production, will produce various IgG antibody products, focusing on molecular and cellular biology, as well as running analytic techniques in the high-throughput/highly-automated lab according to established SOPs, along with working with sensitive equipment and following good manufacturing practices. Candidates must also be a team player, neat and highly organized, able to work in a cleanroom environment and foster safe work practices.

The Manufacturing Associate will perform basic reagent handling, chemistry and molecular biology workflows in a highly automated, high-throughput manner and will be responsible for the manufacture and analysis of a variety of custom DNA based intermediates and products across Twist Bioscience’s proprietary process workflow to meet the Twist production forecast and timelines. 

The ideal candidate will be driven and will do what it takes to keep manufacturing on track in a fast paced start-up environment.  The Manufacturing Associate will be responsible for the production of custom gene based products and/or various intermediates according to established SOPs and complete manufacturing batch records to contribute to the daily production schedule.  

Roles and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Manufacture high quality custom products in a high throughput MFG lab according to established SOPs.
  • Operate laboratory equipment and liquid handling robots such as Hamilton Stars, bioanalyzers, centrifuges, sealers, thermocyclers, spectrometers, Illumina Next-Gen sequencers etc.)
  • Effectively use molecular and cell biology processes and techniques, especially PCR, DNA quantitation, purification and cloning. 
  • Maintain thorough, accurate and detailed documentation of all work performed using existing document templates and software applications.
  • Update and write work instructions and documentation.
  • Work independently and in a safe manner.
  • Pay great attention to details and perform consistent work without excessive supervision.
  • Help Leads and Supervisors with troubleshooting and the handling of process deviations.
  • Package and/or organize products for shipping.
  • Work according to Good Manufacturing and ISO practices. Learn, adopt and promote lean manufacturing concepts.
  • Complete all the daily assigned tasks to keep the manufacturing schedule on track and report back to Lead and Supervisor.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Relevant experience that can indicate success in a high throughput, fast pace laboratory manufacturing environment.
  • Associates or Bachelors degree in Biology, chemistry or related field is desirable.
  • Familiarity or prior experience in a manufacturing and/or a laboratory environment is highly desirable.
  • Good written and verbal skills are critical.
  • Good computer skills (Excel, Word, Atlassian etc) and the ability to quickly learn new software applications.
  • Ability to pay great attention to details.

Working Conditions

  • The work will be performed in a very dynamic laboratory team environment.
  • It is a controlled laboratory environment.
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time while performing duties.
  • Must be able to work safely with chemicals and hazardous materials.
  • Must be able to lift up to 20 lbs.
  • Must be able to work outside of regular work hours/ work a flexible shift as needed

 

Please indicate shift preferences in your application.

Possible Shifts:

1A: Sun-Tues, alt Wed, 7am-7:30pm
1B: alt Tuesday, Wed-Friday, 7am-7:30pm

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

title: Scientist, Neurodegeneration
description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to restore cell health and resilience through cell rejuvenation to reverse disease, injury, and the disabilities that can occur throughout life.

For more information, see our website at altoslabs.com.

Our Value

Our Single Altos Value: Everyone Owns Achieving Our Inspiring Mission.

Diversity at Altos

Altos Labs has been named one of the Top 3 Biotech Companies and ranked for the second year on the Forbes 2026 Best Startups in America list.  At Altos, exceptional scientists and industry leaders from around the world work together to advance a shared mission. Our intentional focus is on Belonging, so that all employees know that they are valued for their unique perspectives. We are all accountable for sustaining a diverse and inclusive environment.

What You Will Contribute To Altos

 

Join Altos Labs at the Bay Area Discovery Science center and play a pivotal role in our mission to reverse brain aging. We are seeking a driven neuroscientist with deep expertise in neurodegeneration to join our highly collaborative, fast-paced team. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional experts to discover and validate optimal therapeutic targets for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. If you are passionate about translating complex biology into transformative therapies, we want you on our team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Science: Act as the scientific lead for a key segment of our neurodegeneration portfolio. You will shape critical research questions, design robust experiments, and drive studies through to actionable, interpretable conclusions.
  • Model Disease Biology: Design and execute in vivo studies using rodent models of neurodegeneration, strategically selecting models, timepoints, and endpoints tailored to specific biological questions and program stages.
  • Analyze Complex Tissue: Process and analyze both rodent and human brain tissue. This includes dissection, regional sampling, fixation, cryopreservation, sectioning, and comprehensive downstream characterization (molecular, biochemical, and histological).
  • Innovate Quantitative Readouts: Develop and apply precise quantitative readouts for pathology and disease biology, tracking markers such as protein aggregation, neuroinflammation, cell loss, and vascular integrity.
  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner closely with internal experts—including in vivo pharmacology, histology, molecular biology, computational, and program management teams—as well as external collaborators and CROs to seamlessly deliver on shared timelines.
  • Champion Scientific Rigor: Establish and promote the highest technical and cultural standards across our scientific functions. You will help embed foundational practices—such as experimental rigor, blinding, randomization, data provenance, and reproducibility—into our day-to-day operations.
  • Drive Strategic Decisions: Actively contribute to program strategy and high-level decision-making, providing critical input on go/no-go recommendations. We value transparent communication, so you will be expected to flag risks early and candidly.
  • Ensure Data Integrity: Maintain rigorous, traceable records and structured data capture, ensuring your findings can be easily reviewed, reproduced, and built upon by the wider team.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep a close pulse on the latest neurodegeneration literature and proactively bring relevant external developments to bear on our internal research programs.

Who You Are 

The level of the position will depend on the qualifications of the selected candidate.

Minimum Qualifications, Knowledge, Skill and Abilities

Core Expertise & Credentials

  • Neurodegeneration Specialist: You hold a Ph.D. in Neuroscience (or a related field) backed by 1+ years of post-doctoral or industry research experience focused on neurodegeneration.
  • Disease Biology Deep-Dive: You bring a robust understanding of neurodegenerative disease biology, including a nuanced perspective on the strengths and limitations of the rodent models used to study it.
  • Proven Track Record: You have an established publication record in the field and are accustomed to presenting your findings at conferences or similar scientific venues.

Technical & Experimental Capabilities

  • Hands-on Analyst: You have extensive, practical experience processing and analyzing both rodent and human brain tissue samples.
  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.
  • Therapeutic Fluency: You have experience working with therapeutic modalities relevant to the Central Nervous System (CNS), such as AAV-based approaches, ASOs, or small molecules.
  • Data-Driven Design: You possess strong quantitative and statistical judgment, enabling you to design appropriately powered studies, analyze complex data, and interpret results objectively without over-extrapolating.
  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.

Scientific Mindset & Adaptability

  • Fiercely Independent & Rigorous: You are highly self-directed—capable of defining a problem, selecting the right approach, and driving it to a conclusion with minimal oversight. You practice rigorous critical thinking and are always willing to interrogate your own data or change your position when the evidence warrants it.
  • Thrive in Dynamic Environments: You are comfortable and composed in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where priorities can shift, decisions carry real weight, and quality must be sustained under pressure.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Cross-Functional Collaborator: You excel at working across disciplines and possess the strong communication skills needed to present complex technical datasets clearly to broad, mixed audiences.
  • Standard Bearer: You are enthusiastic about defining, implementing, and championing technical and cultural standards (like experimental rigor and reproducibility) across our scientific functions.

Preferred Qualifications, Knowledge, Skill and Abilities

  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.
  • Omics Interest: You have some exposure to analyzing biological datasets and a strong desire to build deep expertise in transcriptomics, proteomics, or spatial approaches.
  • Technical Foundations: You possess basic skills in bioinformatics data processing or programming (e.g., Python or R) and are eager to apply these to large-scale data management.
  • Human Cohort Awareness: You are interested in expanding your knowledge of working with human post-mortem or biopsy samples and the unique challenges of cohort-level data.
  • Technique Expansion: You are motivated to learn advanced imaging techniques, spatial biology, or high-content quantitative histology to enhance your research.
  • Collaborative Teamwork: You demonstrate strong potential for growth and a commitment to working effectively within a high-performing, collaborative team environment.
  • Clear Communicator: You are a clear and effective communicator, capable of presenting technical information to your peers and cross-functional partners.

NewLimit is seeking a Scientist to design, formulate and characterize targeted LNPs (tLNPs) with antibody conjugates, Nanobodies, and scFv’s to build our targeting LNP platform with a particular focus on getting nucleic acid payloads into target cells and tissues beyond the liver.

This is a hands-on bench role with targeting compositional and reaction design ownership. You will work closely with the Delivery Sciences and biology teams to design and build relevant targeting lipids portfolio for New Limit’s pipeline programs.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop LNP compositions and conjugation chemistries for antibodies, nanobodies, scFv’s, peptides, and other targeting moieties across multiple structural families, pushing the platform beyond current-generation materials for extra-hepatic targeting.
  • Plan conjugation reactions and purification for these modalities with scale and final purity in mind from the outset, delivering against agreed project timelines.
  • Test targeting lipids for the tLNP platform using an SAR-based approach to guide the next design cycle.
  • Develop conjugation chemistries in-house or work with external partners to get the targeted LNPs for a particular target cell and build processes to support research teams to test the tLNPs in vivo.
  • Turn in vitro and in vivo data from discovery teams into concrete structural hypotheses and optimize the tLNP compositions or the type of targeting molecules used.
  • Present experimental results, and SAR conclusions, authoring protocols and technical reports.

Nice to have

title: Customer Facing Research Analyst
description:
Customer Facing Research Analyst

Truveta transforms healthcare into intelligence. Built with and owned by US health systems united by a mission of Saving Lives with Data, Truveta powers breakthrough discoveries, auditable data fit for regulatory submissions, and AI that improves patient care.

At Truveta, we are building something that has never existed before, bringing together healthcare, science, and technology to tackle some of the most important challenges in human health. Our mission calls us to think big, move with urgency, and build with purpose. We are looking for exceptional people who are energized by hard problems, inspired by the opportunity to improve health, and committed to building a company and culture where talented people can do their best work.

Our team is a special combination of software, health, and big data experience. We are building a talented team of passionate, mission-oriented, and innovative thinkers. 

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest, but we have employees who live across the country.  Our team enjoys the flexibility of a hybrid model and working from anywhere.  In person attendance is required at least once per year for an onsite meeting. 

For overall team productivity, we optimize meeting hours in the pacific time zone. We avoid scheduling recurring meetings that start after 3pm PT, however, ad hoc meetings occur between 8am-6pm Pacific time. #LI-remote

Who We Need 

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

This Opportunity 

This Customer Facing Research Analyst position is a high impact, customer-facing role that requires a diverse set of skills spanning technical execution, applied research methodology, and relationship management. You will work directly with life sciences partners to translate research questions into analytical approaches, execute studies using real-world Electronic Health Record (EHR) data (~120M+ patients), and guide customers in best practices for real-world evidence generation.

You will play a key role in advancing customer research by helping shape analytical approaches, ensuring methodological rigor, and driving projects forward from question to insight. While customers may define or co-develop study protocols, you will provide guidance on study design, bias considerations, statistical approaches, and interpretation of results. This role requires balancing rapid-response analytical support with deeper, more complex investigations, while maintaining a high bar for scientific rigor and customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with life sciences customers to understand research questions and translate them into analytical approaches
  • Required to excel in providing technical analytics support as well as directly working with customers on calls to troubleshooting customer analysis.
  • Use technical skills to scope out customer analyses requests, produce studies and results using SQL, R and Python within an agreed upon deadline.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, acting as a key partner in advancing their research goals
  • Apply appropriate research methodologies, including cohort design, bias mitigation, and statistical analysis
  • Communicate on the status of various projects and collaborate with success managers to ensure that Truveta clients can be successful with the platform.
  • Guide customers on best practices in real-world data research, including study design tradeoffs and interpretation of results
  • Lead customer-facing discussions to unblock research challenges and drive projects forward
  • Collaborate with customers to support peer-reviewed publications and high-quality research outputs
  • Deliver both rapid-response analyses and deeper, in-depth investigations depending on customer needs
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for customer analyses, code, and notebooks
  • Create enablement materials as the Truveta platform evolves to help onboard new researchers to our increasing capabilities.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to investigate data quality and demonstrate data reliability
  • Deliver feedback to internal teams based on customer requests to inform Truveta’s product roadmap.

Required Skills

  • Undergraduate or graduate degree in clinical research, epidemiology, biostatistics, data science, clinical informatics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience working in a technical customer-facing role, delivering high-quality research studies & analyses.
  • 3+ years of experience wrangling and analyzing Electronic Health Record data or other Real World Data sources in life science companies, CROs, other EHR data companies or healthcare organizations.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, R and/or Python for statistical analysis
  • Experience working across large, multi-domain healthcare datasets with millions of patients and hundreds of millions of records, leveraging distributed computing frameworks for scalable analysis.
  • Willingness to learn new coding languages including internal proprietary coding language to analyze data and build cohorts.
  • Strong understanding of real-world evidence principles, including bias, confounding, and study design considerations.
  • Demonstrated experience applying research methodologies, including cohort design and statistical approaches.
  • Experience delivering high-quality product demonstrations that enable customers or stakeholders to understand and effectively leverage data, platform capabilities, and analytical workflows.
  • Proven ability to learn, adapt, and independently drive multiple projects forward in a fast-paced, start-up environment.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to build credibility and trust across stakeholders and effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both executive and technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

These qualifications are preferred but not required. Candidates will have opportunities to develop these skills over time.

  • Advanced degree (MS, MPH, PhD) in epidemiology, biostatistics, health economics, or related field
  • Experience supporting or contributing to peer-reviewed publications or conference abstracts
  • Knowledge of advanced statistical methods such as regression, propensity score methods, survival analysis, and longitudinal data analysis
  • Experience applying methods for causal inference or handling incomplete data in observational research
  • Experience with Spark/PySpark or distributed data processing
  • Experience with Regression, Propensity Score Matching, Kaplan-Meier Analyses, or Survival Analyses
  • Experience working in customer-facing or consulting-style roles
  • Demonstrated ability to present research findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Why Truveta?   

Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together.  

We Offer:

  • Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage
  • Great benefits package
  • Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans
  • 401K plan
  • Professional development & training opportunities for continuous learning
  • Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
  • Generous parental leave
  • Regular team activities (virtual and in-person)
  • The base pay for this position is $110,000 to $160,000. The pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target. Pay is based on several factors including location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  This role is eligible for stock options.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.

Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude Black and Indigenous people, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people. We strongly encourage individuals with these identities to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements.

Please note that all applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer as we are unable to sponsor work visas or permits (e.g. F-1 OPT, H1-B) at this time. We appreciate your interest in the position and encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)

About the Role: 

Care Delivery is the infrastructure that powers how Maven members access care and how our providers deliver it. Every program we run across maternity, fertility, menopause, and pediatrics, depends on it. It's where clinical workflows, provider tooling, and the systems that make care measurable, billable, and scalable at Maven's scale all come together.

We're looking for a Product Manager to help build that platform: the EHR and clinical tooling, provider workflows, messaging, and the data and billing infrastructure that turn Maven's care model into something reliable and scalable. You'll own defined capabilities within the platform and drive them from problem to shipped, in close partnership with engineering, clinical, design, and operations. It's a high-leverage seat. What you build here touches every program Maven offers.

You'll report to the Group Product Manager, Care Delivery, and work closely with our providers, as well as Clinical Product, Member Experience, Operations, and the Data and AI Platform teams.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own specific Care Delivery capabilities end-to-end, provider workflows, clinical documentation, messaging, scheduling and matching, or quality and billing infrastructure, from problem definition through launch and iteration.
  • Make crisp, well-reasoned product decisions, especially where clinical accuracy and provider experience are both at stake.
  • Use AI hands-on to move faster, prototyping with AI tools to test ideas and pressure-test flows before committing engineering time, and identify and build AI-powered capabilities into the care delivery platform where they genuinely improve the provider or member experience.
  • Partner daily with engineering and design to ship reliable platform capabilities, and with clinical and operations partners so that what you build works for real providers and members.
  • Translate regulatory and quality requirements, like HEDIS measures and clinical coding, into clean product experiences that add value without adding friction.
  • Instrument what you ship, watch how it performs, and iterate. Bring data to every decision.
  • Build platform primitives, reusable capabilities that serve many programs, rather than one-off features.
  • Bring a point of view on how AI can improve care delivery workflows, and put it to work in how you build.

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 3+ years in product management, ideally with some time in healthcare tech or another complex, regulated, or operations-heavy domain.
  • A strong executor: you take ambiguous problems, break them down, and ship, without needing everything defined for you.
  • Solid data instincts: you define the right metrics, work with real datasets, and communicate findings clearly to both clinical and commercial audiences.
  • Comfort with technical and clinical complexity: you can hold your own in an engineering sprint and a clinical review, and you're eager to learn the domain fast (FHIR, interoperability, EHR workflows).
  • Genuine care for providers and members: the people using what you build show up in your decisions.
  • Clear, direct communication and strong cross-functional collaboration.
  • Fluency with AI and a genuine desire to build with it: you understand how modern AI models work well enough to know where they're reliable and where they aren't, you reach for AI tools to prototype and think, and you're excited to ship AI-powered features rather than just talk about them.
  • Bonus: experience with EHR or EMR systems, clinical workflows, healthcare interoperability, or provider-facing tools.

title: AI Imaging Specialist - Radiology
description: Latch builds rigorous scientific benchmarks ( benchmarks.bio ) for AI agents across biology. We work with frontier labs and pharma to measure whether agents can handle real biological workflows: the messy, multi-layer reasoning that matters in the field. AI agents can now work through an imaging study the way a radiologist does: open the dataset, explore the dataset based on an indication, identify relevant features based on experience and tools and validate findings. Having agents being involved in the interpretation of clinical samples or even in the diagnosis of patients requires enormous care as well as validation of capability, but also offers massive advantages for patient care. We're building RadiologyBench and are looking for people who work with medical images every day, whether you read studies or acquire them. About the Role You’ll decide what the right answer is for each case and build the studies that test it, from whether a scan was acquired properly to what shows. You then go through how AI agents actually handled them, including what they missed and what they reported that isn’t there. Labs use these results to see where their models fall short of an expert. The work covers MRI, CT, ultrasound and radiography, across organ systems. Designing the task Write the questions that are frequently asked by radiologists or during interpretation of medical images Decide on the optimal answer format that the agent should use Decide what counts as a pass given the objective Review what agents are actually doing and if their approach holds up Help pick what is actually needed by the agent to solve the objective Requirements Can work with medical images professionally and have handled thousands of studies, your role could include: Radiologist, including trained outside the US (board-certified or equivalent) Radiology resident or fellow Sonographer (ARDMS or equivalent) MRI or CT technologist (ARRT or equivalent) Deep experience in at least one modality (MRI, CT, ultrasound or radiography) and working familiarity with the others You know normal anatomy and common pathology for your area, and you can tell when the image itself is wrong: artifact, positioning, parameters Comfortable enough to work with python on interpretation and run scripts. No specific ML engineering is required but could come in handy AI-ready, daily use of popular agents like Claude Code, with judgement to distinguish between technical correctness but clinical unsoundness Bonus: imaging AI challenge experience ( e.g. RSNA, MICCAI, …) or contributions e.g. to Radiopaedia Bonus: familiarity with public imaging archives (TCIA, MIMIC-CXR, UK Biobank, OpenNeuro) Compensation $140K–$180K OTE (on-target earnings), with no ceiling. Your pay is your OTE times your weekly quota attainment. Hit quota, earn your OTE; double it, earn double. Example: $150K OTE at double quota = $300K. Your first 4 weeks (ramp) are paid at full OTE while you learn our workflows. You’re paid full OTE whenever quota can’t fairly apply: when a new project is starting, the platform goes down, or we pull you onto a special project. Benefits & Employment In the US: full-time W-2 Guaranteed floor (“base salary”) set by your state, paid on the 15th and last day of every month Health, dental, vision: 100% covered for you, 50% for dependents 401(k) (no match) PTO: 15 days to start, more as you’re promoted Outside the US: contractor Paid on performance. We want our team to have stability, so we pay 60% of your monthly OTE up front as an advance, balanced against your earnings in later paychecks. US benefits don’t apply. Growth Two tracks, based on output. Individual contributor: six levels, so up to five promotions, with OTE rising at each one. Management: after your first promotion, you can move into managing a pod or keep growing on the IC track. Location & Work Authorization Location: remote or onsite at our Mission Bay office in San Francisco. Onsite is preferred: working side by side is how we share knowledge and keep our work rigorous. We have a global team, and remote teammates regularly visit the office. Work authorization: we sponsor H-1B (new and transfers), O-1, and TN, and support STEM OPT. Culture @ Latch We practice radical transparency: you’ll know how the company is doing, what’s working, and what isn’t. It’s always us against the problem, never each other. We’re opinionated but respectful of each other’s time, and we think through possible solutions before bringing a problem to anyone. We use AI constantly, so we reward original expert judgment, not AI output passed off as your own. You’ll start on the bench that fits your expertise and can move across teams as you build a track record. Outside of work: company outings most months, team off-sites, and a community that does cycling, soccer, figure skating, boxing, running, martial arts, music, books, and game nights. Interview Process Apply. If your profile matches, we’ll send you a take-home project. Take-home project (HackerRank). We review it as soon as it arrives. Technical interview with a Member of Technical Staff (pod lead). Culture interview with our C-suite. Offer. Background check, once you accept.
